definitions: A political ideology advocating for a democratic political system alongside a socialist economic system, with a focus on social ownership and democratic control of the means of production.
A political movement that seeks to achieve socialist goals within the framework of a democratic government.
examples: Many argue that democratic socialism offers a path to greater economic equality.
The debate around democratic socialism often involves discussions about the role of government in the economy.
Advocates of democratic socialism believe in universal healthcare and education.
